title: An essay should be a boundary container with its own composition (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Let's try to create a pdf of the theory of change essay in muSrs.

It should contain references and sources.

An essay is supposed to be structured with a boundary container that can be exported ... But this may not be implemented yet.

An essay may also need to have it's own composition...
